recent_request_intensity.physical_meaning: trailing mean of absolute arrived task count per configured task vehicle
recent_request_intensity.source: tasks.csv formal arrivals plus popularity_history.csv prior request_count, derived from prior completed primitive slots

recent_input_load_intensity.physical_meaning: trailing mean input-bit workload per configured task vehicle
recent_input_load_intensity.source: tasks.csv input_size of arrived tasks in previous completed formal slots
recent_input_load_intensity.causal_cutoff: j < start_slot; at most H=20 available completed formal slots; no input prehistory was imputed
recent_input_load_intensity.empty_history_convention: 0.0 when no completed formal slot is recoverable at episode start

recent_cpu_load_intensity.physical_meaning: trailing mean requested CPU-cycle workload per configured task vehicle
recent_cpu_load_intensity.source: tasks.csv cpu_cycles of arrived tasks in previous completed formal slots
recent_cpu_load_intensity.causal_cutoff: j < start_slot; at most H=20 available completed formal slots; no CPU prehistory was imputed
recent_cpu_load_intensity.empty_history_convention: 0.0 when no completed formal slot is recoverable at episode start

recent_popularity_prediction_error.physical_meaning: historical h=0 service-share prediction residual, not future-uncertainty oracle
recent_popularity_prediction_error.source: popularity_predictions.csv rho_pred at h=0 plus observed service request counts rebuilt by build_observed_popularity
recent_popularity_prediction_error.causal_cutoff: prediction at origin j uses cutoff j-1; residual is consumed only when j < start_slot has completed
recent_popularity_prediction_error.normalization_equation: mean(0.5 * L1(rho_pred_j, rho_obs_j)) over prior completed formal slots
recent_popularity_prediction_error.denominator_provenance: probability-simplex vectors; 0.5*L1 is naturally bounded by 1
recent_popularity_prediction_error.empty_history_convention: 0.0 when no formal prediction residual is yet observable
